name: Government high-performance data center initiative
notes: Official Government of Anguilla social post describes a National Development Fund vision including providing the government with a high-performance data center and strengthening information-storage infrastructure. Public source does not state a site-specific location; assigned to The Valley because central government IT functions are based in the Secretariat Building in The Valley. VOA/AP context says Anguilla does not yet have its own AI industry and that .ai domain services are being moved to Identity Digital's globally distributed servers, so this is not evidence of a hyperscale/colocation campus.
